name: claude-plugin-to-antigravity
description: Port a Claude Code plugin to Google Antigravity, as a native Antigravity plugin: skills with rewritten path anchors and host-valid names, an Antigravity hooks.json whose adapter runs the PreToolUse hooks (deny blocks, ask opens the permission dialog), mcp_config.json, rules file. Installs under ~/.gemini/config/plugins (read by the desktop app and the agy CLI), or builds a portable bundle that installs by unzipping. The Antigravity command of the claude-plugin-port engine.
author: Flavien Chervet
